tasks.short: Play the music under the show.

steps.what: Show the cue already written for this live show.
Provide musical background for live shows such as ballets, operas, and musical theatre.
Hold when the stage is not where the cue said.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the cue already written for the live show, whether ballet, opera, musical theatre, or cabaret. The musician provides the musical background. The musician holds when the stage is not where the cue said. The cue does not play. A show with no cue leaves the screen blank.
tasks.previous_blocker: The cue was a marked score, and a late scene change was taken on a look to the stage.
tasks.enabler_now: A written cue can be shown. Playing under the show, and holding for the stage, stay in the pit.
tasks.still_hard: A scene can run long, and the musician has to hear the stage rather than the printed cue.
tasks.human_edge: The musician plays the background and holds for the stage. The cue is only what was written.
tasks.altitude: The pit stays with the musician. The cue is visible, and a hold for the stage is still the musician's.

reach.task: Stay with a scene that runs long.
reach.learn: The printed cue is not the timing of the stage.

evidence.claim: A cue already written can be displayed. It does not provide the musical background.
Holding for the stage is the musician's decision in the show. The cue cannot see the stage.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A musician or singer in a mid-size European company. A score on screen is not a performance, and a draft note is not the research.
Fields: The show id and the cue only if it is already written. The cue is not composed here. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the musician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the cue from the score already in the document store.
unknowns: Whether ballet, opera, and cabaret share one cue form.
research_questions: Who writes the cue, the conductor or the musician?

already_counted.description: Playing the show and holding for the stage stay with the musician.

incremental.description: File cues against shows that have closed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The musician still provides the musical background and still holds when the stage disagrees with the cue. Only showing a cue already written is removed. A show with no cue saves nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Play from memory or from the score.

steps.what: Show the score page already held for this piece.
Play from memory, or by following the score.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the score page if the company already holds it. The musician plays from memory or by following that score. The page does not play the piece, and it is not turned into a new score from a recording. A piece with no held page leaves the screen blank, and the musician plays from memory.
tasks.previous_blocker: The score was a paper part, and a memory lapse had no page within reach.
tasks.enabler_now: A score already held can be shown. Playing from it, or from memory, stays with the musician.
tasks.still_hard: Knowing the piece well enough to leave the page takes practice, not a display.
tasks.human_edge: The musician plays. The page is only the score already held.
tasks.altitude: Playing stays with the musician, from memory or from the score. No recording is turned into a score by this task.

reach.task: Speak a line from memory or from the book.
reach.learn: The book does not speak the line.

evidence.claim: Showing a score page the company already holds is a lookup. It does not play the piece.
Turning a recording into a new score is a different task and is not done here. The musician plays the page or plays from memory.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A musician or singer in a mid-size European company. A score on screen is not a performance, and a draft note is not the research.
Fields: The piece id and the score page only if it is already held. A recording is not transcribed into a score. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the musician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the score from the document store before printing a part.
unknowns: Which pieces this musician is expected to play from memory.
research_questions: Who checks that the held page is the edition the group is using?

already_counted.description: Playing from memory or from the score stays with the musician.

incremental.description: Replace a score page when the group changes edition.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The musician still plays from memory or by following the score. Only showing a page the company already holds is removed. No recording is transcribed, and a piece with no page saves nothing.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the musical part handed out for this rehearsal.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the musical part if it was already handed out for the rehearsal. The musician sight-reads it during the rehearsal. The screen does not read the part and does not make a part from a recording. A rehearsal with no part leaves the screen blank.
tasks.previous_blocker: The part arrived on paper at the first rehearsal, and there was no earlier file to open.
tasks.enabler_now: A part already filed can be shown. Sight-reading it during the rehearsal stays with the musician.
tasks.still_hard: Reading an unseen part in time with the others takes the musician's eye and ear.
tasks.human_edge: The musician sight-reads. A file of the part is not the reading.
tasks.altitude: Sight-reading stays in the rehearsal. The part is shown only when it was already handed out.

reach.task: Read an unseen side at a first rehearsal.
reach.learn: Having the page is not reading it in time.

evidence.claim: Showing a part already handed out is a lookup. It does not sight-read the music.
A recording is not turned into a part for this task. The musician reads the page in the rehearsal.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A musician or singer in a mid-size European company. A score on screen is not a performance, and a draft note is not the research.
Fields: The rehearsal id and the part only if it was already handed out. The part is not transcribed from audio. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the musician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the part from the document store before printing it again.
unknowns: How often the part arrives only as paper at the rehearsal.
research_questions: Who distributes the part before the musician sees it?

already_counted.description: Sight-reading during the rehearsal stays with the musician.

incremental.description: Remove parts for rehearsals that were cancelled.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The musician still sight-reads the part during the rehearsal. Only showing a part already handed out is removed. A rehearsal with no filed part saves nothing, and no audio is turned into a score.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Choose new music and learn it.

steps.what: List pieces already in the held library for this ensemble size.
Seek out and learn new music suitable for live performance or recording.
Set aside a piece that is not suitable for that performance.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store lists pieces already in the company's library that match the ensemble size on the record. The musician seeks out and learns new music, and decides which piece is suitable for live performance or for recording. A piece that is not suitable is set aside. The list does not choose. A library with no ensemble size is not filtered.
tasks.previous_blocker: New music was a pile of scores, and suitability was decided only after a piece had already been programmed.
tasks.enabler_now: Held pieces can be listed by an ensemble size already recorded. Learning them, and judging suitability, stay with the musician.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a piece suits this voice, this group, or this recording is not on the library card.
tasks.human_edge: The musician chooses and learns the music. The library list is not that choice.
tasks.altitude: Learning new music stays with the musician. The library lists pieces already held, and the musician still decides suitability.

reach.task: Choose a text that fits the occasion.
reach.learn: A shelf list is not the choice.

evidence.claim: Listing pieces already held, filtered by an ensemble size already recorded, is a query. It does not decide that the music is suitable.
A fingerprint of a performance identifies what was played after the fact. It does not choose repertoire, and it is not used here.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A musician or singer in a mid-size European company. A score on screen is not a performance, and a draft note is not the research.

Fields: The ensemble size already recorded, and the piece ids already in the library. Suitability is not a stored field and is not filled in by the list. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the musician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Query the document store already used for scores before adding a catalogue.
unknowns: Whether the library records ensemble size on every score.
research_questions: Who may add a score to the held library?

already_counted.description: Choosing and learning the music stay with the musician.

incremental.description: Remove pieces that have left the library.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The musician still chooses and learns new music and still sets aside what is not suitable. Only listing pieces already held for a recorded ensemble size is removed. A library without that size saves nothing, and no fingerprint chooses the repertoire.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The musician still plays the show, still follows the score or plays from memory, and still sight-reads. A new piece is learned only after the musician decides it is suitable.
reach: Audio and video technicians cue a show, and this job learns the pit still plays the music.
Poets, lyricists and creative writers choose what fits a purpose, and this job learns a catalogue is not that choice.
skills_to_grow: Play the show from the score or from memory.
Sight-read the part in the rehearsal, off the page.
Decide that a new piece is suitable before learning it.
role.ambitious_version: Show playing, memory, and sight-reading stay with the musician. A held library can list pieces, and the musician still chooses what is suitable.
